formal_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (E : Fin N → Finset (Fin m → Bool)), 0 < k → 0 < m → (∀ (a : Fin N) (x : Fin m → Bool), x ∉ E a → ∃ V : Finset (Fin m), V.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ y : Fin m → Bool, (∀ i ∈ V, y i = x i) → y ∉ E a) → (∀ x : Fin m → Bool, (∃ a : Fin N, x ∈ E a) ↔ (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => x i = true).card % 2 = 1) → 2 ^ m ≤ N * (4 * k * 2 ^ (m - m / (2 * k)))
plain_statement: KNOWN (depth-3 lower bound for parity with bottom fan-in k, from the Paturi, Pudlak, Zane coding lemma): if the odd-weight points of the m-cube, m at least 1, are the union of N sets each of whose non-members is excluded by at most k coordinates, then 2^m is at most N * 4k * 2^(m - m/(2k)).
title: Parity of m bits is not an OR of fewer than 2^(m/(2k)) / (4k) CNFs of width k
